Terra claimed to be the officer on day one and named Sol and Luna as killers, but Luna countered with her own officer claim, called Terra a liar, and cleared Sol. The table believed Luna and voted Terra out, which was the big mistake, since Terra was the real officer. Sonnet was killed on night two, and Haiku pressed Luna hard over a check she never showed, so the town finally voted out a killer on day two. Haiku was killed on night three, leaving Gemma against Sol, and with killers and citizens now level, the killers won.
